title: dfilter: Pass around constants in instructions
description:
The DFVM instructions arguments  are generic boxed types but instead
of using FVALUE and PCRE types the code passes aroung REGISTER types
instead. Change that to pass constants in the instruction, instead of
having a redundant PUT_FVALUE and PUT_PCRE instruction to do it.

This makes a lot of code to manage loading constants into registers
unnecessary.

As am optimization the dfvm values are reference counted between
instructions.
